what.title: What is chess?
what.text: Chess is a strategy game for two players, more than a thousand years old. Each side commands an army on the board and tries to capture the enemy king.

goal.title: The goal
goal.text: Checkmate: the enemy king is attacked and has no way to escape.

board.title: The board
board.text: 64 squares (8 × 8). Each side has 16 pieces: 1 king, 1 queen, 2 rooks, 2 bishops, 2 knights and 8 pawns.

first.title: How to play
first.text: Players take turns making one move. White goes first, one piece per turn.

coordinates.title: Meet the board
coordinates.text: Read the names of the squares: number rows, letter columns.

path.title: Your learning path
path.text: This order is the easiest. Every lesson is short, with pictures, a voice and a chance to try it yourself.

pieces.title: Meet the pieces
pieces.text: How each piece moves: watch, then try.

openings.title: Learn openings
openings.text: Famous ways to start a game, explained move by move.

play.title: Play for real
play.text: Play the computer at several levels, or a friend.

more.title: Like other games?
more.text: Xiangqi, Caro, O an quan, Sea Battle… Play the computer, friends with a room code, or ranked quick match.

join.title: Got a room code?
join.text: Enter the 6-character code your friend sent to join the room.

office.title: Office
office.tagline: Put it on the projector, everyone joins from their phone with their own animal, and watch who gets picked. Fair and verifiable.
office.avatarSoon: Coming soon: pick an animal and dress it up your way: fur colours, eyes, accessories… It will follow you into every session.

create.title: The host opens a session
create.text: Ask a question like "Who buys the bubble tea?" and project the stage with its code and QR.

join.title: Everyone scans the QR
join.text: Pick your animal on your phone. It shows up on the big screen right away.

draw.title: Spin!
draw.text: Animals race or the wheel spins on every screen at once. Anyone can verify the result.

lucky-animal.name: Lucky animal
lucky-animal.text: Randomly pick one or more people with an animal race or a wheel.

team-split.name: Team split
team-split.text: Split the team into even groups in seconds.

random-order.name: Random order
random-order.text: A fair order for presentations or stand-ups.

prize-draw.name: Prize draw
prize-draw.text: Several prizes, several rounds, one win per person.

avatar.title: My animal
avatar.intro: This animal represents you in every office session. Dress it up your way; every change is saved automatically.

verify.title: Round {round}: was it fair?
verify.okDetail: Your browser just recomputed the draw from scratch and got exactly these people.
verify.badDetail: The commitment or the result does not match the published data.
verify.stepCommitment: The SHA-256 of the seed matches the commitment published before the spin
verify.stepWinners: Recomputing {n} of {total} candidates gives the same result
verify.how: How: sort the candidates by id; for pick i, take the first 8 bytes of HMAC-SHA256(seed, "drawId:i") modulo the number of people left, and take the person at that position. The server cannot change the seed once the commitment is published.
verify.notFound: This draw wasn't found (or hasn't finished yet).
verify.loadFailed: Couldn't load the data. Please try again later.
verify.stepPrizes: Recompute the prize of the person picked, with the same seed, from the {total} prizes public from the start
verify.prizes: Prizes at the time of the draw ({n})
verify.prizesHow: For Lucky money: L = limited note, U = unlimited note, B = a wish; the number after it is the value row.

present.hint: Project your laptop directly: hides the controls, Space to spin, Esc to leave.

party.title: Party games
party.tagline: One person opens a room on the TV or projector, everyone scans the QR code and joins with their own animal. No phone? The host adds their name.

create.title: Open a room
create.text: Pick a game, set it up (for example the lucky money notes), then show the code and QR code.

join.title: Everyone joins
join.text: Scan the QR code, enter a name and pick an animal. The host adds anyone without a phone.

play.title: Watch together
play.text: Effects, music and sounds play on every screen at once. Results are fair and verifiable.

li-xi.name: Lucky money (Tết)
li-xi.text: One by one, people are called up to open a red envelope and see how much they got. You set the notes and how many of each.

tet-quiz.name: New Year quiz
tet-quiz.text: Everyone answers riddles on their phone. Who is fastest?

fortune-shake.name: Spring fortune shake
fortune-shake.text: Everyone takes a shake and gets a lucky wish.
